description: This file contains an abstract class 'AbstractStorelessUnivariateStatistic' that provides a default implementation for univariate statistical calculations without storing all data. It includes methods for evaluating statistics over arrays, handling external references, and defining core abstract methods for subclasses. It is part of the 'org.apache.commons.math3.stat.descriptive' package.

classes.name: AbstractStorelessUnivariateStatistic
classes.description: An abstract class providing default implementations for univariate statistics that do not store all data, supporting evaluation, incrementing, copying, and comparison functionalities.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the statistic on the entire array or a subarray, throwing an exception if the input is null or indices are invalid.

methods.name: incrementAll
methods.description: Adds an entire array or a portion of it to the statistic by incrementally updating the internal state.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of this statistic instance.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the statistic.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Returns the current value of the statistic.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Increments the statistic with a new data point.
